correctness.rationale: Under Chen’s default ambient d_orb,n, pick the identity factor I_n. Registered rank-s candidate row vectors all lie in one s-dimensional subspace U with orthogonal projection P and p_i=P_ii, Σ p_i=s. Cauchy–Schwarz bounds each row cosine above by sqrt(p_i), hence its squared angle below by f(p_i)=acos²sqrt(p_i). Calculus gives fʺ(p)=2(sin2θ−2θcos2θ)/sin³(2θ)>0 for p=cos²θ, as the numerator vanishes at θ=0 and has derivative 4θsin2θ>0. Jensen gives Σf(p_i)≥n f(s/n)≥n f(r/n). Real Schur–Horn majorization supplies rank-r projection with uniform diagonal r/n in every dimension, and Y=√(n/r)P attains the bound; strict convexity and equality in rowwise Cauchy–Schwarz yield exactly (n/r)P, with no other minima. Rank n gives zero distance and unique I_n; rank1 gives sign-cut matrices; corank1 projections I−ssᵀ/n give exactly 2^(n−1) signed-simplex correlations. The proof addresses n≥2 and all 1≤r≤n and explicitly distinguishes smaller ambient k metrics. Independent DFT projections for all 170 n/r pairs n≤18 and 1620 sampled rank-bounded row subspaces numerically corroborated its claims; the universal proof is analytic and does not follow from finite tests.
residual_risks: Finite verification is not an infinite-dimensional rank/dimension proof; analytic Cauchy–Schwarz, convexity, Schur–Horn are decisive.

value.rationale: Rank strata are intrinsic organizing subsets of the elliptope quotient geometry, and exact metric clearance from the canonical full-rank basepoint I_n to rank loss is a natural stability/nearest-degeneracy question. The finding supplies a nontrivial closed form simultaneously for every n and r, a complete variational/equality classification by uniform-diagonal projections, and all exactly 2^(n−1) signed regular-simplex nearest singular correlations. The angular cost is not the familiar quadratic frame potential, so the result is not a mere reparameterization or known-table calculation. The optimized metric and full equality set are mathematically useful even without a separate downstream theorem.
residual_risks: The finding concerns only identity-centered distances and does not solve arbitrary pairwise correlation quotient distances or lower ambient metrics.
The natural mathematical use is rank-loss clearance and optimizer geometry; particular applications to statistical estimators or numerical algorithms are not asserted.
